title: A Tiny Shrimp's Snap Hits 218 Decibels and Flashes Light

scenes.text: A tiny shrimp snaps its claw and makes a 218 decibel bang.
The claw shoots a water jet at about 60 miles an hour.
It leaves a bubble that collapses and passes 4,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
The collapse even gives off a brief flash of light.
All that comes from a claw about half the size of its body.
A gunshot underwater, fired by a shrimp. Watch that snap again.

description:
The pistol shrimp snaps its claw so fast it makes a bubble that collapses with a 218 decibel bang.
The bubble passes 4,000 degrees Fahrenheit and flashes light.
The claw is about half the size of its body.
What's the loudest sound you've ever heard?
first_comment: Would you rather meet a pistol shrimp or a mantis shrimp?
